The 34 missed hours decompose, each hour measured (NP6-905 hourly + SCED-interval grain; 60-Day SCED disclosure curves): 25 energy-side, of which 6 offer-formed on loaded event shoulders — adjudicated OUT-OF-ADMISSIBLE-REPRESENTATION by ERCOT-75: the prints formed on measured fleet ROOM EXHAUSTION (online remaining room 0.1-0.6 GW, sub-$200 sliver 82-465 MW; the $965+ level lives in the CT marginal-room tail, whose loaded-state support is event-only per the pre-registered bias gate, and whose price-side projection is provably inert vs the DAM mode-B ladder; the quantity-side projection — capping availability at the observed envelope — is the rule-14 actuals-pin family); ~6 ramp-formed sub-hourly (HDL-basis exhaustion with HASL room — out of hourly representation); ~8 congestion/stranding outside the zonal reduction (SCED stranded 0.4-1.9 GW of cheap-offered renewables the model dispatches — owned by the West/Panhandle topology charter); 5 January-unreachable (SCED-disclosure retention wall); plus 8 sub-hourly transients and 1 reserve-driven (01-22 h8, RTORDPA $90 — RTORPA is never decisive except that hour). The caveat therefore stands as a measured representation limit, not an open mechanism lane; the sole remaining in-model lever on this count is the topology charter's ~8 congestion hours. 2023 reads 179h vs RT 181h (0.99x, PASS) and 2025 19h vs 31h (0.61x, PASS) on the same basis.
